metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle clips through solid object
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a car or vehicle pass through, overlap, or become embedded in a solid object such as a fence, container, debris pile, or another vehicle? Look for vehicle meshes intersecting with barriers they should collide with.

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC or person clips through structure
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC or character walk through a closed door, stand inside furniture, or have their body partially overlapping a solid object like a wheelchair, container, or wall?

metamorphic_relations.name: Vehicle launched or floating
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a car, motorcycle, or other vehicle launched into the sky, hovering above the road, or sent flying from a minor collision or while parked? The force should be disproportionate to the cause.

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC teleports or instant pose change
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC instantly snap to a new position or pose without any walk, stand-up, or transition animation? Look for characters suddenly appearing in a different stance or location between frames.

metamorphic_relations.name: Object rotates or vibrates without cause
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a box, shelf, crate, or other prop spinning, rotating, or vibrating on the ground with no character or force acting on it?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC or object despawns visibly
metamorphic_relations.check: Does an NPC or object abruptly disappear from the screen while the player is looking at it, with no explosion, death, or door to explain it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Invisible held item
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character holding, swinging, or using an invisible weapon or object? Their hands are empty but their animation suggests they are gripping something.

metamorphic_relations.name: Game freeze mid-action
metamorphic_relations.check: Has the game frozen completely — the frame is stuck, animations stop, but HUD or particle effects may still be visible? This is distinct from a pause menu.

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC remains in combat state without threat
metamorphic_relations.check: Do NPCs remain crouched, aiming, or shouting combat dialogue even though all enemies are dead and no gunfire or threat is present? They should return to normal civilian or patrol behavior.

metamorphic_relations.name: Summoned vehicle fails to arrive or spawns underground
metamorphic_relations.check: After calling a personal vehicle, does it fail to appear, spawn partially inside the ground, or appear flipped or stuck in terrain instead of arriving normally on a nearby road?

metamorphic_relations.name: T-pose or frozen animation state
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character appear stuck in a T-pose or frozen idle pose while still moving or sliding across the ground? Their animation rig should respond naturally to movement.

metamorphic_relations.name: Objective marker present but no interact prompt
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a quest objective marker visible, but the required object or NPC cannot be interacted with despite being in range? There should be a usable prompt when conditions are met.

metamorphic_relations.name: Dialogue audio missing but subtitles active
metamorphic_relations.check: Do subtitles display for a conversation while no voice audio plays, even though other ambient sounds and effects are functioning normally?

metamorphic_relations.name: HUD element persists after context ends
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a tutorial hint, phone UI, braindance overlay, or scanning effect remain on screen after exiting that mode or finishing the related activity?

metamorphic_relations.name: Traffic vehicle stops permanently without obstruction
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a traffic car stop in the middle of a clear road and remain stationary indefinitely, even though there is no visible obstacle or red light?

metamorphic_relations.name: World geometry fails to load while player can move
metamorphic_relations.check: Can the player move freely while buildings, roads, or terrain fail to load, leaving empty space or void areas where geometry should exist?
